units.name: Marketing and Business Information Systems Department
units.school: William G. Rohrer College of Business
units.evidence: Current department directory places Supply Chain and Logistics under this combined department. Its degree page explicitly names the department and details supply chain strategy, logistics, transportation, inventory and manufacturing/procurement teaching.

units.name: Construction and Engineering Management
units.school: Henry M. Rowan College of Engineering
units.evidence: Official division and program pages establish the actual division and explicit teaching in quantitative decision making, operational system design and logistics.

decisions.reason: SCM/Logistics is shorthand for a program/remit; retain the official department that houses Supply Chain and Logistics.

sources.note: Official university homepage and identity checked.
Official business and engineering college names verified.
Department list assigns Supply Chain and Logistics major to Marketing and Business Information Systems.
Explicit supply chain, inventory, transportation and logistics teaching; links Marketing and Business Information Systems Department.
All six departments read; no standalone industrial engineering department listed.
Construction and Engineering Management is explicitly a division.
Division teaches quantitative decision making and operational system design; explicit logistics coverage.

limitations: Combined Marketing and Business Information Systems department is included because its explicit supply chain remit is verified; no standalone information systems unit is included.
Construction and Engineering Management is a division with relevant teaching, not an industrial engineering department.
